metadata.title: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Section 2 PBN & RNAV 문제은행
metadata.note: 원문 p.393–408 범위에서만 출제. Figure 1-2-1~1-2-6 연결 포함.

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: PBN에서 RNP와 RNAV NavSpec을 구분하는 핵심 차이로 맞는 것은?

choices.text: RNP는 onboard performance monitoring and alerting을 요구한다.

questions.explanation: RNP는 RNAV에 onboard performance monitoring and alerting(OBPMA)을 추가로 요구한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.393

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: PBN의 지정 RNAV/RNP accuracy는 최소 어느 비율의 flight time 동안 충족되어야 하는가?
questions.explanation: Jeppesen은 PBN accuracy requirement를 비행시간의 최소 95% 동안 충족하도록 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.393

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: NavSpec의 숫자가 나타내는 것은?
questions.explanation: RNAV/RNP NavSpec의 numerical designation은 NM 단위 lateral navigation accuracy를 뜻한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.393

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: PBN의 두 주요 navigation specification 계열은?
questions.explanation: PBN 내 두 주요 계열은 RNAV와 RNP이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.393

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP의 onboard monitoring/alerting capability 예로 원문이 든 것은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 RAIM을 onboard performance monitoring and alerting capability의 예로 든다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.393

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: PBN에서 “RNAV”라는 용어의 기본 의미는?
questions.explanation: 절차 title에서 RNAV는 장비 capability와 무관하게 area navigation을 의미한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.393

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: NavSpec은 무엇의 집합인가?
questions.explanation: NavSpec은 defined airspace concept에서 navigation application을 지원하기 위한 aircraft/aircrew requirements의 집합이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.393

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: FIG 1-2-1에서 RNAV 10은 주로 어느 application 쪽에 표시되는가?
questions.explanation: FIG 1-2-1은 RNAV 10을 oceanic and remote navigation applications에 배치한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.393

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNAV의 정의로 가장 적절한 것은?

choices.text: 원하는 flight path에서 ground/space-based 또는 self-contained aids를 이용하는 area navigation

questions.explanation: RNAV는 ground/space-based aids, self-contained aids 또는 조합의 capability 내에서 원하는 flight path로 운항하게 한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.394

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: 원문이 제시한 RNAV의 잠재적 장점이 아닌 것은?
questions.explanation: RNAV는 효율을 높이지만 ATC clearance 자체를 없애지는 않는다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.394

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Waypoint는 기본적으로 무엇으로 정의되는가?
questions.explanation: Waypoint는 latitude/longitude coordinate로 정의되는 predetermined geographical position이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.394

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Fly-by waypoint에서 turn은 언제 시작되는가?
questions.explanation: Fly-by는 waypoint 전에 다음 course로 turn anticipation을 시작한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.394

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Fly-over waypoint의 특징은?
questions.explanation: Fly-over는 해당 waypoint를 실제로 통과한 뒤 turn을 시작한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.394

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Fly-by에서 waypoint 전에 turn을 시작하는 개념은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 이를 turn anticipation이라 부른다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.394

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNAV DP/STAR를 비행할 때 특히 요구되는 것은?

choices.text: Procedure centerline에 대한 엄격한 awareness와 유지

questions.explanation: RNAV procedure는 procedure centerline awareness와 유지가 중요하다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.394

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: 원문이 RNAV route/terminal procedure guidance와 함께 참고하도록 한 AC는?
questions.explanation: Domestic RNAV DP/STAR/route guidance는 AC 90-100도 참고한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.394

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNAV leg type의 두 글자 code는 무엇을 설명하는가?
questions.explanation: Leg type two-letter code는 path와 termination point를 나타낸다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.395

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Track to Fix(TF) leg에 대한 설명은?
questions.explanation: TF는 다음 waypoint까지의 track을 intercept하고 acquire하는 leg이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.395

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Direct to Fix(DF) leg는?

choices.text: Initial area에서 next waypoint로 direct track

questions.explanation: DF는 initial area에서 다음 waypoint로 직접 향하는 track이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.395

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Course to Fix(CF) leg는?
questions.explanation: CF는 specified course at the fix로 종료된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.396

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Radius to Fix(RF) leg는?

choices.text: Defined turn center 주위 constant-radius circular path

questions.explanation: RF는 defined turn center 주위의 일정 반경 곡선으로 fix에서 종료된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.397

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Heading to Altitude의 leg code는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 Heading to Altitude를 VA 예로 든다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.397

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Heading to DME range의 leg code는?
questions.explanation: Heading to DME range는 VD이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.397

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Heading to Manual Termination(Vector)의 leg code는?
questions.explanation: Heading to Manual Termination, 즉 Vector는 VM이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.397

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: TSO-C129/C196/C145/C146 GPS/WAAS system에서 departure/arrival airport를 입력하는 이유는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 proper RAIM availability와 CDI sensitivity 확보를 위해 입력하도록 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.398

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: DME/DME position updating에 영향을 주는 요소가 아닌 것은?
questions.explanation: DME/DME는 system logic과 facility proximity/availability/geometry/signal masking에 의존한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.398

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: VOR/DME position updating은 일반적으로 무엇보다 less accurate할 수 있는가?
questions.explanation: VOR 특성 때문에 GPS나 DME/DME보다 less accurate할 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.398

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: IRU/INS가 DME/DME 또는 GPS와 결합되는 주된 목적은?
questions.explanation: Inertial system은 다른 input과 결합해 overall navigation performance를 개선한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.398

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: FMS의 구성 설명으로 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: FMS는 sensors, receivers, computers와 navigation database가 통합된 system이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.398

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: FMS input으로 원문에 열거되지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 GPS, DME, VOR, LOC, IRU를 input 예로 든다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.398

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Appropriate signal이 있을 때 FMS가 position update에 보통 우선적으로 사용하는 것은?
questions.explanation: FMS는 보통 GPS 및/또는 DME/DME를 주 position update source로 사용한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.398

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: DME/DME와 하나 이상의 IRU 결합을 흔히 어떻게 약칭하는가?
questions.explanation: DME/DME/IRU는 D/D/I로 약칭할 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.398

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNAV 1이 전형적으로 사용되는 곳은?
questions.explanation: RNAV 1은 보통 DP와 STAR에서 사용된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.399

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNAV 1의 total system error 기준은?
questions.explanation: RNAV 1은 95% 시간 동안 total system error 1 NM 이하이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.399

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNAV 2의 전형적 사용은?
questions.explanation: RNAV 2는 별도 지정이 없으면 보통 en route에 사용된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.399

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: T-route와 Q-route는 어떤 NavSpec의 예인가?
questions.explanation: 원문은 T-route와 Q-route를 RNAV 2 예로 든다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.399

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNAV 10은 전형적으로 어디에 사용되는가?
questions.explanation: RNAV 10은 보통 oceanic operations에 사용된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.399

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP의 핵심 추가 요구사항은?
questions.explanation: RNP는 onboard performance monitoring and alerting을 추가 요구한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.399

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP 1 eligibility가 자동으로 의미하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: NavSpec은 서로 별개이므로 RNP 1이 RNP 2/RNAV 1을 자동 의미하지 않는다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.399

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: Database에 특정 PBN procedure가 보이지 않을 때 가능한 이유는?

choices.text: Aircraft가 해당 PBN element에 ineligible하거나 계산/비행할 수 없음

questions.explanation: FAA safeguard상 database는 aircraft eligibility에 맞는 procedure만 보유하므로 이런 가능성이 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.399

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: 미국에서 RNP APCH의 chart title은?
questions.explanation: RNP APCH는 미국에서 RNAV (GPS)로 title된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP APCH가 제공할 수 있는 minima 조합은?
questions.explanation: RNP APCH에는 LNAV, LNAV/VNAV, LPV, LP minima가 있을 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: LPV 또는 LP minima 사용에 필요한 것은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 LPV/LP minima에 SBAS 사용을 요구한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP APCH에서 RF turn capability는?
questions.explanation: RNP APCH eligibility에서 RF turn은 optional이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP APCH final approach의 lateral accuracy는 본질적으로 어디까지 scale하는가?
questions.explanation: Final approach에서 RNP 0.3까지, SBAS 사용 시 40 m까지 scale한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: 미국에서 RNP AR APCH의 chart title은?
questions.explanation: RNP AR APCH는 RNAV (RNP)로 title된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP AR APCH에서 mandatory인 capability는?
questions.explanation: RNP AR APCH에서는 scalability와 RF turn capability가 mandatory이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP AR APCH vertical navigation은 무엇을 기반으로 하는가?
questions.explanation: RNP AR APCH vertical navigation performance는 baro-VNAV 또는 SBAS 기반이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP AR DP 운항에 필요한 것은?
questions.explanation: RNP AR DP는 stringent standards와 special FAA authorization이 필요하다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.400

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: RNP AR DP initial departure path의 lateral accuracy는 최소 어느 값보다 낮게 scale하지 않는가?
questions.explanation: 원문은 initial departure flight path에서 RNP 0.3보다 낮게 scale하지 않는다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.401

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: A-RNP의 미국 mandatory function이 아닌 것은?
questions.explanation: A-RNP minimum functions에는 RF turns, scalable RNP, parallel offset path generation이 포함된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.401

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: 일부 oceanic/remote continental airspace에서 A-RNP에 추가로 요구될 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 higher continuity such as dual systems가 요구될 수 있다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2 · p.401

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 2. PBN & RNAV
questions.study_unit_title: Section 2. Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and Area Navigation (RNAV)
questions.question: 미국에서 A-RNP의 optional en route advanced option 예는?

choices.text: Fixed radius transitions와 Time of Arrival Control

questions.explanation: 원문은 fixed radius transitions와 Time of Arrival Control을 optional advanced options로 든다.
